name: glyhub_GPST000599_serum_n
title: Septic shock longitudinal serum N-glycome
description: Complete published glycan-by-sample peak-area matrix, 45 source glycan features and 134 samples; paired fractional abundance block preserved.
details: Complete 45-feature by 134-sample glycan peak areas exactly match publisher SI Table S3. Relative abundance verified raw/column sum. Patient-ICU day naming is explicit in publisher SI; all 134 samples mapped without ambiguity to 37 subjects and actual sampling dates in S1. Clinical missing values N/A/Unknown remain null. Other SI tables are identification PSMs, narrow Lex subsets or peptide LFQ and are not imported as glycan matrices.
